title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta1

## Read-only private API field probes

This prerelease starts the 0.4.5 beta line with a bounded development action for validating several read-only Navimow private-cloud endpoint families across mower models before any of the returned data is promoted into normal entities or production polling.

### New development action

- Add `navimower.probe_private_api` under Home Assistant Developer Tools -> Actions.
- The action is intentionally allow-listed: it accepts only `trail`, `reports`, `terrain`, `weather`, `rtk`, or `all`; it cannot call an arbitrary endpoint or submit an arbitrary payload.
- Probe output is written under `/config/navimower_diagnostics/probes/` with a timestamped file plus a per-probe latest file.
- One failed endpoint or request variant is retained as an error result instead of aborting the whole probe batch.

### Endpoint families under test

- **Trail:** read `get-path-info-time`, collect unique `partitionId` values, then test `/vehicle/trail/get-path-info-data-compress` using a JSON `partitionList` array. This is intended to determine whether vendor-retained swept-path geometry can supplement or replace trail reconstruction from MQTT positions.
- **Reports:** test `/vehicle/report/vehicle-main-report` plus day/week/month `/vehicle/report/get-day-week-month-data` calls through the existing authenticated private-cloud transport.
- **Terrain:** test `/mowerbot/map/queryDynamicsMap` and `/mowerbot/vehicle/common/get-iot-file` with `type=2`, including bounded `vehicle_sn`/`sn` request variants. The goal is to establish whether LiDAR-capable models expose a dynamic/terrain resource used by the Navimow app.
- **Weather:** test `/vehicle/vehicle/get-vehicle-weather` for vendor weather-state data such as rain, storm, frost, snow and high-temperature decisions.
- **RTK:** test `/mowerbot/vehicle/rtk/queryRtkService` as a possible direct RTK/nRTK provisioning/status source.

### Privacy and safety

- All probes are explicit user-triggered reads; no new endpoint is added to normal coordinator polling in this beta.
- No mower-control or settings-write endpoint is exposed by the probe action.
- RTK account/password values are recursively redacted before probe files are written.
- Probe files can still contain mower identifiers and exact map/location data, so they remain development captures and should be reviewed before sharing publicly.

### Compatibility

- No entity IDs, storage formats, mower controls, map geometry, Schedule behavior, gate logic or normal diagnostics contract are changed.
- No Navimower Map Card update is required for this prerelease.
